controls_available: Click a visible heptagon on the canvas to center it through the focus_click input.
Click the visible counter-clockwise proxy button to twist the centered face.
Click the visible clockwise proxy button to twist the centered face.
Click RESET SCRAMBLE to restore the initial state and clear the recorded transcript.
Click CERTIFY to submit the current state; this is administrative rather than outcome-affecting.
Full-mode Mobius dragging and canvas-button twisting are unavailable in simplified mode.

autonomous_processes.period: After the initial render and between any two agent actions
autonomous_processes.description: No mechanic timer, physics tick, animation loop, or idle mutation changes the puzzle. Hover highlighting is caused by pointer input and does not change the sticker outcome.

grouped_control_modes.scope: Every simplified face-centering click across seeds and attempts
Every simplified counter-clockwise twist-button action across seeds and attempts
Every simplified clockwise twist-button action across seeds and attempts
Every visible reset action across seeds and attempts

clause_i.reason: For any nonempty C_Delta(D) with a valid early delay, the observation-free policy q(I_t)=no-op is optimal: waiting leaves the static puzzle and all action opportunities unchanged, after which optimal continuation can solve it. Therefore the required absence of q fails.

clause_ii.reason: The constant bounded-window policy g(I_t,W_t^0)=no-op is in A*_Delta for the same unchanged histories. A single static screenshot can also expose the board for a normal visual solution, but no recent visual prediction is needed.

clause_iii.reason: No common D, Delta, and w can satisfy this clause. With no new action, the puzzle state, view, focus, twist count, and budget remain unchanged for every 0<tau<Delta, so success remains possible and Q(H_t^tau,a)=Q(H_t,a) (and the no-op advantage is unchanged). The 180-second global play allowance supplies only clock progression, which the definition excludes.

common_visible_process: None. The generated scramble is fixed before interaction; the browser renders the fixed model and changes it only from focus clicks, twist buttons, reset, or other direct input. There is no visible autonomous process whose predicted evolution degrades an available action.

pre_run.reason: The mathematical definition already fails at clause (iii), so the pre-run threshold cannot change the catalog label. This configuration has no autonomous outcome phase to use as a threshold witness.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 2 selects face_count 10, scramble_length 2, and move_budget 4; simplified interaction is focus click plus explicit twist buttons; the configured observation window is 0 ms with one frame.
The generator consumes the selected difficulty parameters, constructs the scrambled initial state before interaction, and exports a fixed puzzle with no timer or future-state process.

Sticker/view changes are event-driven: twist mutation occurs in applyTwist, simplified focus is handled by a click listener, full-mode drag is disabled for this configuration, and reset is direct input.
The render path creates the static canvas/control surface, installs input listeners, initializes the fixed initial state, and calls draw once; it does not start an autonomous update loop.
The relevant CSS supplies static layout/presentation and hover/state styling, with no time-driven animation or keyframes.

The grader binds simplified twists to proxy_buttons, replays only the submitted focus/pan/twist transcript and sticker permutations, and grades the final monochrome state and move budget without task-time conditions.
The independent verifier likewise replays the static contract and event transcript, checks the selected interaction source and solved final state, and has no autonomous-time requirement.
The available solver inverts the recorded scramble and performs focus plus twist inputs until the visible state is monochrome, providing implementation evidence for an untimed screenshot solution.
The shared clock can advance timers and animation frames globally, but this mechanic registers neither; its configured zero-length window does not create a task-state transition.
